title: Round-Trip AI: Who Is Financing Their Own Customers?

edges.conditions: Letter of intent. Investment staged progressively as each gigawatt of NVIDIA systems is deployed.
edges.quote: NVIDIA intends to invest up to $100 billion in OpenAI as the new NVIDIA systems are deployed
edges.notes: Corroborated at T1 without an amount: Nvidia 10-Q acc 0001045810-25-000230 says it entered a letter of intent with an opportunity to invest in OpenAI. Largest single LOI in the ledger, so the LOI weight dominates sensitivity.

edges.quote: OpenAI and Broadcom announce strategic collaboration to deploy 10 gigawatts of OpenAI-designed AI accelerators
edges.notes: AMOUNT ZERO: no dollar value disclosed by either party. Racks targeted to start in the second half of 2026 and complete by end of 2029.

edges.quote: up to one million TPUs, dramatically increasing its compute resources, worth tens of billions of dollars
edges.notes: WIDE RANGE ON PURPOSE. The only figure given is the phrase tens of billions of dollars, which this project reads as $20bn to $90bn. No point estimate is defensible. Over a gigawatt expected online in 2026.

edges.quote: our $13 billion of total funding commitments to OpenAI as an investment under the equity method
edges.notes: Extractor had tagged the $250bn Azure purchase as an equity investment; corrected on review. Microsoft holds about 27% of the OpenAI PBC on an as-converted diluted basis.

edges.quote: OpenAI has contracted to purchase an incremental $250 billion of Azure services
edges.notes: Disclosed in a subsequent-events note alongside the new definitive Microsoft and OpenAI agreement. Microsoft simultaneously gave up its right of first refusal to be OpenAI's compute provider.

edges.quote: The total contract value is approximately $2.9 billion
edges.notes: The earlier November 2025 Meta agreement for two dedicated GPU clusters, separate from the March 2026 agreement.

edges.quote: Anthropic has committed to purchase $30 billion of Azure compute capacity
edges.notes: Announced the same day as the Microsoft and NVIDIA investment commitments into Anthropic, which makes this the tightest two-sided round trip in the ledger after the AWS and Anthropic pair.

edges.conditions: Committing to invest up to this amount; no closing disclosed.
edges.quote: NVIDIA and Microsoft are committing to invest up to $10 billion and up to $5 billion respectively in Anthropic
edges.notes: Announced jointly with Anthropic's $30bn Azure purchase commitment, which is the matching demand edge.

edges.conditions: Agreement subject to certain closing conditions.
edges.quote: we entered into an agreement, subject to certain closing conditions, to invest up to $10 billion in Anthropic
edges.notes: Anthropic's Series G release says a portion of the previously announced Microsoft and NVIDIA investments participated in that round.

edges.quote: a securities purchase agreement with NVIDIA Corporation for a private placement for aggregate gross proceeds of $2.0 billion
edges.notes: About 23 million Class A shares at $87.20. CoreWeave's proxy states NVIDIA beneficially owns more than 5% of its capital stock.

edges.conditions: Vests in tranches on AMD Instinct GPU purchase milestones by OpenAI plus AMD stock price and stock performance thresholds; each vested tranche needs further technical and commercial conditions before exercise.
edges.quote: we issued to OpenAI a warrant to purchase up to 160 million shares of AMD's common stock at $0.01 per share
edges.notes: AMOUNT RECORDED AS ZERO ON PURPOSE. The instrument is share-denominated and AMD discloses no dollar value, stating the warrant had no impact on its financial statements. It therefore contributes nothing to the dollar-weighted bounds but does count as a funding LINK for the UPPER bound. Issued alongside a 6 gigawatt product purchase agreement.

edges.quote: $30 billion in Series G funding at a $380 billion post-money valuation
edges.notes: RANGE ON PURPOSE. Series G total $30bn, co-led by D.E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ and MGX with GIC and Coatue. The release says the round included a portion of the previously announced Microsoft and NVIDIA investments but does not say how large that portion is, so the non-supplier share is bounded between $15bn and the full $30bn.

edges.conditions: Amazon may purchase at its sole discretion; obligated to buy any remainder on the earlier of OpenAI meeting specified milestones or an OpenAI public listing.
edges.quote: Amazon Sub agreed to purchase shares of OpenAI's Series C Preferred Stock with an aggregate purchase price of $35.0 billion
edges.notes: 8-K Item 1.01, equity commitment letter agreement. Amazon guaranteed the obligations of its subsidiary.

edges.quote: a pre-funded Class A ordinary shares purchase warrant in a private placement for aggregate gross proceeds of approximately $2 billion
edges.notes: Pre-funded, exercise price $0.0001 for 21,065,936 shares, so the cash is received up front. Economically an equity injection by the GPU supplier into its own customer.

edges.quote: These Orders have a total contract value of $12 billion
edges.notes: Firm orders for dedicated GPU capacity clusters, five year duration, deployments in tranches starting early 2027.

edges.conditions: Meta is obligated to buy only the capacity Nebius fails to sell to third parties, for the remainder of five years from initial deployment.
edges.quote: Meta is obligated to purchase such unsold capacity. This Order has a potential total contract value of up to $15 billion
edges.notes: A pure backstop: it converts into revenue only if Nebius cannot sell the capacity elsewhere, so its expected value moves inversely with genuine third-party demand. Recorded separately from the $12bn firm orders so the two are never conflated.

edges.conditions: Consumption of the expanded capacity is dependent on Anthropic's continued commercial success.
edges.quote: Anthropic, beginning in 2027, will access through Broadcom approximately 3.5 gigawatts of next generation TPU-based AI compute capacity
edges.notes: AMOUNT ZERO: 8-K Item 8.01 gives gigawatts but no dollars, and Broadcom's $179.2bn RPO is not broken out by customer. This is the single largest measurement gap in the dataset. The conditionality language is unusually explicit about the customer's ability to pay.

edges.quote: NVIDIA has paid us an aggregate of approximately $326.3 million and $59.6 million, respectively
edges.notes: Related-party disclosure in CoreWeave's proxy: NVIDIA buys CoreWeave's own infrastructure services under an April 2023 master services agreement. Amount is FY2025 plus Q1 2026 cash actually paid, so it is historical rather than forward backlog. Small in dollars, important in structure: the chip supplier is simultaneously an equity holder, a supplier and a customer of the same company.

edges.quote: In Q1 2026, we invested $15.0 billion in Series C Preferred Stock of OpenAI

edges.conditions: Subject to satisfaction of deployment and availability of the GPU clusters. Microsoft may terminate individual tranches on specified delivery delays or repeated availability failures.
edges.quote: the total contract value is estimated to be up to about $17.4 billion through 2031
edges.notes: High end of $19.4bn is the figure Nebius gives if Microsoft acquires the additional services and capacity contemplated by the agreement (424B5 of 12 November 2025). Nebius states the obligations commence only once it confirms it has secured any additional financing required.

edges.conditions: Vests in tranches on AMD Instinct GPU purchase milestones by Meta and specified AMD stock price targets; further technical and commercial conditions before exercise.
edges.quote: In October 2025 and February 2026, the Company issued warrants to OpenAI OpCo, LLC and Meta Platforms, Inc.
edges.notes: Same zero-dollar treatment as the OpenAI warrant. Exercisable through February 23, 2031.

edges.quote: $65 billion in Series H funding at a $965 billion post-money valuation
edges.notes: Series H total $65bn. The release separately identifies $15bn of previously committed hyperscaler investment, including $5bn from Amazon, so $50bn is recorded here as non-supplier money. Led by Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia; co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1, GIC, ICONIQ and XN.

edges.conditions: Committed to invest up to this amount; no closing or tranche schedule disclosed.
edges.quote: AMD has committed to make a strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic
edges.notes: Surfaced by the news monitor from AMD's IR feed, then read and verified. Announced alongside Anthropic deploying up to 2 gigawatts of MI450 GPUs, so it is a supplier funding its own buyer. The RSS feed reported the crawl date 2026-10-05; the release is dated 2026-07-22 and that is the date recorded.

edges.quote: Anthropic to deploy up to 2 gigawatts of MI450 Series GPUs in AMD Helios rack-scale solutions
edges.notes: AMOUNT ZERO: gigawatts only, no dollar value disclosed by either party, and AMD discloses no product backlog. The matching leg of the AMD equity commitment above, and unmeasurable in dollars for the same reason as the OpenAI 6 gigawatt agreement.

edges.quote: In Q2 2026, we invested $5.0 billion in Anthropic Series G nonvoting preferred stock
edges.notes: Two $5.0bn tranches in the same filing: Series G plus Series H via the option to participate in subsequent financings. Covers only 2026 cash; Amazon's earlier convertible notes are carried at fair value, not cost, so they are recorded separately and not added here.

edges.conditions: Nothing drawable at inception. Capacity becomes available only as Amazon reaches compute delivery milestones under the amended AWS commercial arrangement. Expires 30 months after an Anthropic liquidity event.
edges.quote: a financing arrangement to make available to Anthropic an aggregate facility not to exceed $20.0 billion
edges.notes: Headline facility is $20.0bn; the same filing says the Series H investment reduced availability to $15.0bn, which is the figure recorded. This is the clearest vendor-financing instrument in the dataset: availability is explicitly gated on the seller delivering compute.

edges.quote: AWS and Anthropic announced an expansion of the existing multi-year commitment by more than $100.0 billion over 10.0 years
edges.notes: Recorded as a FLOOR. The filing says more than $100.0bn and gives no upper figure, and the pre-existing commitment size is not disclosed, so low equals high equals the floor. Anthropic's own release of 20 April 2026 states it is committing more than $100 billion over ten years to AWS, securing up to 5GW.

edges.quote: an expansion of the existing $38.0 billion multi-year commitment with OpenAI by $100.0 billion over 8.0 years
edges.notes: Extractor had captured Amazon's whole $496bn backlog figure from the surrounding sentence; corrected on review to the OpenAI-specific $38.0bn plus $100.0bn. Includes obligations tied to the performance of AWS chips.

edges.quote: Meta Platforms, Inc. initially committed to pay us up to approximately $21.0 billion
edges.notes: Includes an exercised option for additional capacity through April 2032.

edges.quote: OpenAI committed to pay us up to approximately $6.5 billion through May 31, 2031
edges.notes: Order form under a May 2025 master services agreement.

edges.quote: The Anthropic Services Agreements provide for aggregate payments to us of up to approximately $44.6 billion
edges.notes: Dedicated GPU infrastructure at the Monarch Compute Campus to support NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 deployment. Signed after the 30 June 2026 RPO date.

edges.conditions: Each guarantee becomes effective only on commencement of the applicable lease, across nine construction phases, first expected in fiscal 2029. Terminates if OpenAI achieves a satisfactory credit rating.
edges.quote: we entered into guarantees, capped at a total of $105 billion, to provide credit support
edges.notes: Credit support to SB Energy Corp affiliates on behalf of an OpenAI affiliate, covering about 4.25 gigawatts of IT load at the PORTS campus in Pike County, Ohio. In exchange the site exclusively hosts NVIDIA AI infrastructure. Nvidia holds an option to support a further 3.8 gigawatts.

edges.conditions: Convertible into ordinary shares, or Non-Voting Shares in NVIDIA's case, automatically upon completion of the IPO.
edges.quote: a further $1.0 billion of unsecured convertible loan notes or Non-Voting Shares that will be issued to NVIDIA
edges.notes: Part of a minimum $3.1bn subscription agreement dated 15 September 2026, three days before the S-1 was filed.

edges.conditions: Subject to the satisfaction of delivery and availability of service requirements. Excludes optional extensions.
edges.quote: statements of work with Microsoft that provide for payments to us of up to approximately $43.8 billion through December 2033
edges.notes: Entered between September 2025 and April 2026. Nscale's largest customer was 52% of revenue for the six months to 30 June 2026 and 73% for 2025.

edges.quote: NVIDIA received warrants to acquire up to 9,476,700 of our Series B preferred shares with an aggregate value of $60,000,000
edges.notes: Exercise price $0.01 per warrant share. Granted in consideration for the Ward County lease guarantee. NVIDIA became a holder of more than 5% of Nscale's share capital through the Series B.

edges.conditions: Guarantee of lease obligations; additional contingently exercisable warrants are issuable if Nscale defaults on a lease NVIDIA guarantees.
edges.quote: NVIDIA agreed to guarantee up to $860,340,000 of our obligations under the lease agreement for the facility in Ward County, Texas
edges.notes: The supplier is underwriting its customer's property obligations, which is credit support rather than a sale.

edges.quote: we provide reserved GPU cluster capacity with initial service terms ranging from 12 to 48 months, for an aggregate amount of $1.2 billion
edges.notes: DEMAND edge: Nvidia is the buyer here, under a July 2025 master cloud services agreement. Nvidia therefore funds Nscale three ways and is simultaneously its supplier and its customer.

edges.quote: SBG's cumulative investment in OpenAI totals USD 64.6 billion, and its ownership interest is approximately 13%
edges.notes: Third and final $10.0bn tranche of the $30.0bn follow-on executed 1 October 2026. SoftBank is a pure financial funder here with no compute to sell to OpenAI, so this edge is what keeps supplier provenance shares honest: it is the single largest non-supplier funding line in the ledger.

nodes.discovered_via: Aggregate node, not a company. Holds the non-supplier portion of private-lab funding rounds, which the releases report as a total without per-investor amounts. It exists so the CENTRAL provenance denominator is not composed entirely of suppliers.

S-1 filed 2026-09-18 (acc 0001193125-26-395475). Surfaced while checking for newly filed neocloud registrants. Unlike the incumbent filers it names Microsoft, Anthropic and NVIDIA as counterparties WITH dollar amounts, and discloses NVIDIA warrants, an NVIDIA lease guarantee and NVIDIA convertible notes alongside an NVIDIA cloud purchase, which is the most complete round trip in the dataset.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation tagged at $222 million as of June 27, 2026
backlog_rows.notes: NOT used as AMD's backlog, same reason as Nvidia. AMD's 6 gigawatt OpenAI purchase agreement carries no disclosed dollar value.

backlog_rows.notes: Low = Google Cloud portion, the relevant AI infrastructure backlog. High = group total.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: those commitments not yet recognized were approximately $496 billion as of June 30, 2026
backlog_rows.notes: Amazon does not tag RPO in XBRL after 2020; it discloses unrecognised contract commitments, primarily AWS. Weighted average remaining life 6.4 years.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: the remaining performance obligations under these contracts as of August 2, 2026 were approximately $179.2 billion
backlog_rows.notes: Includes a long-term custom AI accelerator contract. Broadcom names no customer and gives no split.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: As of June 30, 2026, the Company had $103.7 billion of unsatisfied RPO
backlog_rows.notes: 41% expected to be recognised within 24 months.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: Commercial remaining performance obligation increased 84% to $678 billion
backlog_rows.notes: Low = commercial RPO as quoted. High = total RPO 684.0bn from XBRL RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation, same filing.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: the aggregate transaction price allocated to the RPO was $21,333.0
backlog_rows.notes: 20-F, figures in millions. Predates the March 2026 Meta agreement, so this denominator lags the demand edges.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: remaining performance obligations for contracts accounted for as service contracts under ASC 606 were $56.4 billion as of June 30, 2026
backlog_rows.notes: S-1. Up from $34.5bn at 31 December 2025. Predates the 25 August 2026 Anthropic agreements, so this denominator lags the demand edges and the dependency row sum exceeds 1.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation tagged at $3.2 billion as of July 26, 2026
backlog_rows.notes: NOT used as Nvidia's backlog. Nvidia sells data centre systems on purchase orders and discloses no product backlog; this RPO covers software and services only. Metric name is outside the denominator preference list on purpose.

backlog_rows.quote_snippet: Remaining performance obligations were $664 billion as of August 31, 2026
backlog_rows.notes: 10-Q Q1 FY2027. Oracle does not name any customer anywhere in its filings.

cannot_see.detail: Oracle discloses $664 billion of remaining performance obligations and the words OpenAI appear in none of its filings retrieved here. Its round-trip exposure is unmeasurable, not low.

$179.2 billion of RPO including a long-term custom AI accelerator contract, with no customer named and no split. Its 8-K confirms Anthropic will access about 3.5 gigawatts through Broadcom, with no dollar figure attached.
Customer A was 36% of revenue in Q2 2026 and 67% of 2025 revenue. CoreWeave labels customers A to D and never names them, and no counterparty filing names CoreWeave as a buyer of that size.

OpenAI, Anthropic and xAI file no periodic reports. Every figure about them here comes from a counterparty's filing or their own release, so their total funding is a documented subset, never a complete picture, and every number touching them is a range.

cannot_see.gap: Alphabet's Anthropic stake is unquantified here
cannot_see.detail: Alphabet names Anthropic in no filing retrieved, and no Alphabet or Anthropic release found states an Alphabet investment amount. Alphabet's non-marketable securities rose from $68.7 billion to $131.5 billion in the first half of 2026 with no attribution. No edge was recorded, which means Alphabet's measured exposure is zero and almost certainly understated.

cannot_see.gap: Share-denominated warrants carry no dollar value
cannot_see.detail: AMD's warrants to OpenAI and Meta are 160 million shares each at $0.01, and AMD states they had no impact on its financial statements. They are recorded at zero dollars, so they move the UPPER bound through the funding-link test but contribute nothing to LOWER or CENTRAL.

cannot_see.gap: Nvidia and AMD disclose no product backlog
cannot_see.detail: Both sell data centre systems on purchase orders. Their tagged RPO covers software and services only ($3.2 billion and $222 million). The two companies most associated with vendor financing therefore have no measurable backlog denominator at all, which is why they carry no headline number here.

Nebius's RPO is dated 31 December 2025 but its Meta agreement is from March 2026; Nscale's RPO is dated 30 June 2026 but its Anthropic agreement is from August 2026. Both show dependency row sums above 1, flagged rather than rescaled.

Nvidia discloses $36 billion of multi-year cloud service commitments to AI cloud partners and $3.5 billion of lease guarantees for them without naming which. Oracle discloses $288 billion of lease commitments not yet commenced. None of it can be attached to a counterparty.
